items:

 and healthy
 equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 goggles, protective clothing, rubber gloves
No smoking is permitted in battery room.

The door of the battery room must be provided 
 with NO Smoking signs .

The battery instructions must be displayed 
 visibly on the wall..

Water source must be available in the battery 
 room.

When working in the battery room bewares of 
 parts under voltage.

Keep the batteries clean and dry protect them 
 against solid, liquid and gaseous contamination.

Inspect terminals of battery and clean any 
 salt deposits with distilled water.
Clean battery room floor with water.

Check for correct operation of battery room 
 ventilation fan.

Check for the correct position of all vent 
 covers.

Check acid level 10 mm above separators or 
 between max / min levels.

Write down the voltage, temperature, and acid 
 density of pilot cells.

performed on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block

Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Use standard personal safety 
 and healthy
 equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 goggles, protective clothing, rubber gloves
No smoking is permitted in battery room.
The door of the battery room must be provided 
 with NO Smoking signs .
The battery instructions must be displayed 
 visibly on the wall..
Water source must be available in the battery 
 room.
When working in the battery room bewares of 
 parts under voltage.
Tools and Equipment
Hydrometer
Digital voltmeter.
Thermometer
Work to be Carried Out
Keep the batteries clean and dry protect them 
 against solid, liquid and gaseous contamination.
Inspect terminals of battery and clean any 
 salt deposits with distilled water.
Clean battery room floor with water.
Check for correct operation of battery room 
 ventilation fan.
Check for the correct position of all vent 
 covers.
Check acid level 10 mm above separators or 
 between max / min levels.
Write down the voltage, temperature, and acid 
 density of pilot cells.
